objective.source_text: The goal is to maximise the total carat mass held in the vault.

constraints.name: credit_limit
constraints.source_text: Deploy a fixed line of credit of CHF 250,000: the total wholesale price of the stones bought must not exceed it.

constraints.name: slot_limit
constraints.source_text: The retail vault has 60 individual display slots, so at most 60 stones can be held.

constraints.name: volume_limit
constraints.source_text: Total displayed stone volume cannot exceed 9,000 cubic millimetres; a stone's volume is x times y times z.

constraints.name: cut_max_ratio
constraints.source_text: No single cut grade may exceed 30% of the stones held.

constraints.name: clarity_min
constraints.source_text: Carry at least two stones of every clarity grade so the range stays saleable.

constraints.name: capital_high_price_ratio
constraints.source_text: At most 40% of deployed capital may sit in stones priced above CHF 8,000.

constraints.name: light_stones_limit
constraints.source_text: Hold no more than 10 stones lighter than 0.3 carats.
